text: Invading Warriors are orcs located in Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound during Stand Fast.
Invading Spirit-menders are tauren located in Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound during Stand Fast.
Iona Skyblade is an Ascended kyrian located in Elysian Hold.
Ioanna is a steward located at Steward's Rest in Bastion. She may be the objective for the Steward of the Day.

Invasive Mawshrooms are found up trees in Korthia. They contain 0-3x Questionable Mawshrooms, 4-5x Relic Fragment and 6-10x uncommon anima items (30-50 anima). They also rarely contain a Tasty Mawshroom for Darkmaul. While on Diviner's Rune Chits, they also contain 1-2x Diviner's Rune Chit.
The Intricately Etched Letter Opener was never made available.
Invasion: Kirin Tor Shore was rewarded from A Friend In Need. Its placeholder quest was This Is Not a Quest.

Invigorating Fish Sticks are totems summoned by the Murkbrine murlocs in Stormheim during the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market raid.

Intrepid Necklace of Prophecy is created with Legion Jewelcrafting (100); taught by Design: Intrepid Necklace of Prophecy.
__NOTOC__ Invading Scavengers are devourers located in Korthia.

Intrusive Thoughtcage drops from Lords of Dread in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
__NOTOC__ Invading Gorgers are devourers located in Revendreth.

Invasive Salamanthers are salamanthers located in the Earth-Warder's Cauldron in the Forbidden Reach.
Invasive Swoglets are hornswogs located at the Hornswog Grounds and Hoard of Shimmermaw in the Forbidden Reach.
Into the Storm is a expansion features achievement earned for completing its listed achievements.
Invasive Hornswogs are hornswogs located at the Hornswog Grounds in the Forbidden Reach.
Into the Azure begins the Azure Span storyline, offered by Merithra immediately after completing the Ohn'ahran Plains storyline at the Ancient Bough.
__NOTOC__ Invasive Clearwater Snappers are turtles located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Invading Primalists are a tauren, Dark Iron dwarf, and jungle troll that were ordered by Vadne Bleakheart to kill the adventurer and Baby in the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. Thinking they were an easy prey, Baby massacred them.
Investigator Erima is a bronze drakonid located in Thaldraszus.

Invasion Plans: Dragon Nests are contained inside the Djaradin Warchest guarded by Warchanter Ronvath at at Elders' Gift in northwestern Zaralek Cavern. Field Commander Ignax is looking for the plans in Intercepting Communications.
Intricate Zaqali Runes is located at Zaqali Caldera in Zaralek Cavern. Only scribes with 25 points in Dragon Isles inscription may interact with it.
Invoq is a rare elite djaradin that spawns at the Battlefield Ruins in Zaralek Cavern.
Investigator Kandray is a nightborne located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Inundate is an Elemental shaman talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Tumultuous Fissures.
Intrepid Shortblade is created with Classic Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Intrepid Shortblade.

Invader's Satchel of Helpful Goods is a daily reward for doing the Random dungeons through the Dungeon Finder either with the regular dungeons or through the timewalking event.
Iron Ore is mined from Iron Deposits, with a minimum Classic mining skill of 1.

__NOTOC__ Iron Bars are smelted from Iron Ore. The item is used in Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Engineering, and Jewelcrafting. It is smelted at a forge by miners with a skill level of 125 or greater. It requires: *1x Iron Ore
Iron Deposits can be found primarily in zones that have a minimum level of 25, 30, 35, or 40.
The Iron Counterweight is created by the Blacksmithing profession.
__NOTOC__ Iridescent Pearl is a pearl commonly used in tradeskills.

The Iron Lockbox is a lockbox that contains gems, weapons, inventory bags, armor and can be opened from lockpicking. Dropped from level 26 - 50 mobs (mostly elite below level 30 and few over level 37). but mostly dropped from dungeon mobs or bosses.
Iridescent Scale Leggings are mail leg armor with Fire and Frost Resistance but no additional stats.
The Iron Knuckles is a one-handed Fist weapon. The Chance on Hit makes it an effective PvP dual wield weapon for Warriors and Rogues.
Iridescent Fire Opal drops from Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Omor the Unscarred in Hellfire Ramparts.

Iriel was a UI and Macros Forum MVP and contributor to the World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11114 UI & Macros Forum]; including one of three non-employee contributors credited with developing SecureGroupHeaderTemplate Iriel posted as a level 85 female night elf hunter from Silver Hand US. Although he evidently continued playing the game (being level 120 in 2019), Iriel does not have any recent activity on the modern WoW forums under this toon.

Iron Gauntlets of the Maiden epic plate gloves for tanks that drop from the Maiden of Virtue in Karazhan. The original model was similar to the Paladin tier 1 set (Lawbringer), but with a different color.
Iridescent Sprite Darter Wing drops from the following faerie dragons in Feralas: *Captured Sprite Darter *Sprite Darter
Iron Dwarves are iron dwarves found at Baelgun's Excavation Site in the Howling Fjord.

Irk Gaffestone lives in the Badlands of Khaz Modan and aids the dwarven excavators in their unearthing of artifacts. He is one of the few non-humans to serve on the advisory board of The Caretakers, training people how to carve stone to be a fitting hiding place for artifacts. In exchange for his knowledge, the Caretakers give him tips on how best to preserve the artifacts he unearths with his dwarven comrades. He is sixty, and has a black beard and black eyes.

The Iron Hall is located inside Blackrock Depths, and is accessible from the Lyceum. It is a short passage leading directly to the Imperial Seat. This room is lined on both sides with massive statues, and guarded at its end by Magmus. Once Magmus aggros, the statues begin to breathe fire about every 10 seconds; players should be careful to stand in the areas between statues to avoid fire damage.
The Iridescent Shards are found deep within the cave in Drywhisker Gorge in the Arathi Highlands.
This is the door that leads to Ironclad Cove where plans from her juggernaught. Oddly enough there is a cannon pointed right at the door, maybe a blast from that will budge it open.
Irespeakers are level 70 shivarra located in and around the Dawning Square of the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Iron Rune Construct is a single-occupant vehicle created by Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost.
Iron Rune Steelguards are iron dwarves located at Baelgun's Excavation Site in the Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Laborers are iron dwarves located at Ivald's Ruin in Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Golems are iron golems found around Baelgun's Excavation Site in Howling Fjord. Once slain, they can be mined for crystallized earth.
Iron Rune Workers are iron dwarves located at Baelgun's Excavation Site in the Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Runemasters are iron dwarves located at Baelgun's Excavation Site in the Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Stonecallers are iron dwarves located at Giants' Run in the Howling Fjord.
Iron Dwarf Brooch has a chance to drop from any iron dwarf in Northrend.
Iron Eyes is a taunka located in Taunka'le Village in the Borean Tundra. He asks the player to head to the pools to the west and get rid of the left over machinery left by the gnomes.

Iron Thane Furyhammer is the current thane of the iron dwarves located in Dun Argol. His death is the objective of the quests Bringing Down the Iron Thane and The Iron Thane and His Anvil. He is always close to his companion, The Anvil.

Ionar is a lightning revenant, and the third boss found in the Halls of Lightning, located in the Thundering Overlook. Ionar guards the way into Loken's inner sanctum in the Terrestrial Watchtower, stopping all those who would attempt to kill his master.
The Iron-Bound Tome is created with Inscription (400); taught by trainers.

The Iron Crucible is an area within the Halls of Lightning, overseen by the fire giant Volkhan, it's where creatures not affected by the Curse of Flesh were forged for Loken's army. At the time of the war against the Lich King, Volkhan worked many days and nights here to create golems to further the numbers of Loken's armies, and was considered a threat to the existence of the Sons of Hodir who ordered his death. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard visited the Iron Crucible, among them Brann Bronzebeard got in a long conversation here with an unnamed female iron dwarf, now the new overseer in charge of the area since the demise of Volkhan.
__NOTOC__ Irisee is a draenei located in the Silver Covenant Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament.
The Iron Concourse is a subzone of Ulduar located between the Expedition Base Camp and Formation Grounds in the outside part of the instance.
This item is a reward from the quest Into the Breach (Grizzly Hills)
This item is a quest reward from * Eliminate the Competition

The Iron Colossus was built by the stormforged iron dwarves to reinforce Loken's army in Ulduar. The Iron Colossus was made in Narvir's Cradle and Nidavelir in the Storm Peaks, using saronite and iron ore. It also used the Heart of the Storm, without which its weapons would be much weaker. No matter how tough the colossus' armor was, it was still vulnerable to acid, a weakness that Bruor's men took advantage of with their trained, adult jormungar's acid breath.
Iron Dwarf, Medium Rare (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating 25 Dark Rune Guardian Dwarves with Razorscale's Flame Breath in 25-player mode.
Maz'dinah is a Alliance subtlety rogue and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.
Iron Rune Overseers are iron dwarves found at Dun Argol in Grizzly Hills.
Iron Sludge are oozes morphed from two Malformed Oozes during the boss encounter with Sjonnir The Ironshaper in the Halls of Stone instance.
Iron Chef is an achievement that requires the character to learn 200 cooking recipes.
Iron Hammer Bomb is provided as an objective for Striking Back.
__NOTOC__ Iron Sentinels are iron giants located at the Terrace of the Makers in the Storm Peaks.

The Iron Amulet is a common mogu archaeology artifact, created from 50xMogu Archaeology Fragment. Up to one Mogu Statue Piece may be used to solve this artifact. A pristine version can also be crafted.
Iron Qon is the tenth boss encounter in the Throne of Thunder. It is a tank and spank with numerous environment awareness mechanics.

The Iron-Bound Zandalari Journal is a rare drop from Zandalari trolls in Za'Tual, the Beast Pens, and the Conqueror's Terrace on the Isle of Thunder. Looting this book is one of the requirements of the Pandaria quest achievement Zandalari Library Card.
Iron Golem Custodians are iron golems located in the Halls of Stone.
Iron Honor Guards are iron dwarves located, as part of the Thorim encounter, in Ulduar.
Iron Ring Guards are iron dwarves located, as part of the Thorim encounter, in Ulduar.

The Iron Skyreaver was bred for war by brutal Iron Horde beastmasters. Girded for battle in black steel and smoldering flame, and imbued with the blistering rage of the Iron Horde blacksmiths who gave it form, this monstrous chimaera suffers only the most fearsome of masters to ride it. Like a blazing comet foretelling doom and fiery destruction, hurtle down from the heavens upon this epic mount to herald your own campaign of conquest!
The Iron Docks are a massive port located in Gorgrond staffed by the Iron Horde's elite Grom'kar forces.
Iron Horde Grunts are orcs located in the in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal and in the Gardens of Eternity in .
Iron Boltblasters are Iron Horde orcs found in , Talador, and Gorgrond.
Iron Shadowskulkers are orcs attacking Gardens of Eternity in .
Ionis is a rare wind serpent that can be found near the hills on the northern side of the Shifting Mire in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Iridium Dust drops from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim in Talador.

The Iron Starlette is rewarded for completing the pre-expansion launch Warlords of Draenor intro experience quest chain in the Blasted Lands, culminating in the quests Report to the King or Warning Orgrimmar. It was supposed to be no longer awarded after the release of Warlords of Draenor, but continued to be available.
The Iron Horde Weapon Cache is looted from the Weapons Cache in Gorgrond.

The Iron Horde Supplies are found on at an Iron Horde supply wagon that has gotten bogged down in the snow on the path between the Iron Siegeworks and Grom'gar along the Southwind Cliffs. An angry Blackrock Warder shouts invective at the Blackrock Grunts: * * * * * * * Clear out the troops and loot the Iron Horde Supplies crate in the wagon to come away with 30-40x Garrison Resources.
Iron Thunderguards are orcs found in the Bones of Agurak and Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge. They carry torches which are dropped at the player's feet after the orcs are killed.
Iron Gronnlings are gronnlings found at the in Tanaan Jungle during Assault on the Dark Portal. They come in a wave of two.

Iron Horde Cargo Shipment is found at on the north-south trail between Shaz'gul and the Burial Fields in south-central . Guarded by Armsmaster Gokk and two Iron Horde Peons, the chest contains 30-40 Garrison Resources.
Iron Horde Peons are orcs accompanying Armsmaster Gokk and the Iron Horde Cargo Shipment on the north-south path between Shaz'gul and the Burial Fields in .

Iron Horde Invasion! began the pre-Warlords expansion quest chain in the Blasted Lands, the first half of the Warlords of Draenor intro experience. Players logging in after Patch 6.0.2 had gone live saw a "What's New?" window front and center that began this quest. Should players close the window, Hero's Call Boards in all capital cities would also offer the quest. To start the questline, simply abandon Warlords of Draenor: The Dark Portal and take the portal to Vindicator Maraad in the Blasted Lands.
Iron Shredders are shredders located in Mor'gran Logworks in Talador.

Iron Engineers are goblins of the Venture Company found next to a Fallen Draenei Defender and the Iron Shredder Decommission Orders, which starts Decommissioned Mission. They also piloted Iron Shredders.
Iron-Body Ponshu is a pandaren located at the Peak of Serenity in the Kun-Lai Summit.
Iron Belly Spirits is a quest reward from Raising Spirits (Townlong Steppes).
Iron Supply Chest is found at on the east wall of Brak's Excavation in northwestern Gorgrond. It contains 25 Garrison Resources.
Iron Box is found at in the tower just northeast of the Throne of the Witch Lord in western Gordal Fortress in southeastern Talador. It contains roughly and the Gordunni Skullthumper.

The torched Iron Scout is found at northwest of the lake near Aruuna, west of the entrance to the Aruuna Crystal Mine. It and a few other scouts were caught in the arakkoa attack on Aruuna. Interact with the one interactable orc: : : Loot the corpse to come away with 20-30 Garrison Resources.
Iron Horde Scraps drop from any Iron Horde mobs in outdoor and inside Warlords of Draenor instances while characters have a War Mill or the Dwarven Bunker built at their garrison.
Iron Buccaneer's Hat drops from Captain Ironbeard aboard the dreadnaught in Ironfist Harbor in .

The Iron Siegeworks is the Iron Horde's main siege weapons complex in Frostfire Ridge, and the origin of most of the weapons that threaten the Frostwolves there. The Iron Horde captured Thaelin Darkanvil and imprisoned him here. Gazlowe, Hansel Heavyhands, and the Garrison Commanders arrived here to rescue the Dark Iron dwarf and disrupt the siegeworks operations.
The small Iron Sea is located between Frostfire Ridge and Gorgrond, on a sizable bay in northern .
:Not to be confused with The Assembly of Iron in Ulduar. Iron Assembly is an achievement earned from defeating the bosses within the Iron Assembly in Blackrock Foundry.
Iron Docks Challenger is an achievement earned from completing the Iron Docks Challenge Mode.
Iron Docks: Bronze is an achievement earned from completing the Iron Docks Challenge Mode ith a rating of Bronze or better.
Iron Docks: Silver is an achievement earned from completing the Iron Docks Challenge Mode with a rating of Silver or better.
Iron Docks: Gold is an achievement earned from completing the Iron Docks Challenge Mode with a gold rating.
The Iron Maidens - Admiral Gar'an, Enforcer Sorka and Marak the Blooded - are the final boss of the Iron Assembly wing in the Blackrock Foundry.
Iron Bellow Sabatons drop from Operator Thogar in Blackrock Foundry.
Iron Flametwisters are orcs found at the Burning Font in Blackrock Foundry.
Iron Assembly Wardens are orcs found in the Workshop of Blackrock Foundry.

Irius is a draenei located in the Mess Hall in Stormshield. She is playing her harp, much to the enjoyment of nearby Stormshield Guards and Stormshield Peasants.
The Iron Shredder Prototype is a shredder located at Tuurem‎ in Talador.
Iron Horde Rations can be looted from various Iron Horde mobs and objects in Assault on the Dark Portal, the phased level 90 version of Tanaan Jungle.
Iron Armada is an achievement that requires the player to obtain the listed Crashin' Thrashin' toys.

The Iron Bastion is a port located south of the . After retreating from the battle near the , the Alliance and Horde survivors hijack the only two docked ships here to escape from the Iron Horde. The survivors would eventually crash their ships at either Eventide Bay (right next to Eventide Landing) in or at Burning Glacier in Frostfire Ridge. This port is later renamed Zeth'Kur when the area is revisited.
The Iron Approach is an Iron Horde base found in northern Gorgrond, just north from The Pit. It serves as the entrance to the Iron Docks.

Iron Horde Naval Manifest drops from the following orcs in Tanaan Jungle: *Grom'kar Sentry *Grom'kar Leadslinger *Grom'kar Reinforcement *Grom'kar Warsmith *Grom'kar Cauterizer *Grom'kar Dockhand *Sergeant Mor'grak *Grom'kar Warrior *Harbormaster Korak It can also be looted from the following objects: *Bottle of Machinery Grease *Inferno Shot *Box of Iron Horde Equipment

The Iron Shredder Decommission Orders is a book located on a rock on the outside area of Mor'gran Logworks in Talador , apparently having been dropped by a dead Iron Engineer. It starts the quest Decommissioned Mission.

The Iron Bulwark is the courtyard of . Siegemaster Mar'tak attempts to thwart the breaching of the gates in the Hellfire Assault event. Following her failure, she pilots the Iron Reaver against the adventurers.
Iron Lookout's Arbalest can be looted from the Sniper's Crossbow at a small camp just southeast of Drov the Ruiner's area in the Valley of Destruction in Gorgrond.
Iridescent Dreamleaves can be found in Val'sharah on the Broken Isles. They are a variant of Dreamleaf that give off a warm glow, while being pleasant to the touch.
Iron Black Rook Hold Key is a reward from Where In the World is Mathias?: Black Rook Hold.
Ionized Geographical Recorder is provided by Didi the Wrench for Extraterrestrial Exploration.
Iron Reaper Deckhands are located aboard The Iron Reaper above the Shimmering Expanse.
The Iron Gunnery Sergeant is an orc located in Blackrock Foundry. He is mounted on a siegemaker.
Iron Flameseers were orcs located in Gorgrond that were taken out by the followers sent from the Lunarfall and Frostwall garrisons to inspect war machine.
Iron Grunts are orcs located in various parts of . They participated in the Assault on the Dark Portal, Karabor attack, Highmaul fights, and also attacked Lunarfall.
Iron Pulverizers were siege weapons of the Iron Horde located in Gorgrond that were taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrison.
__NOTOC__ Iridium Geodes are geodes located in Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
Iron Guards are orcs located in Frostfire Ridge. They accompanied Krugmok Wolfscream‎ to the Bloodmaul ogres, but they were killed by Borgal Doomfist‎.
Iron Siege Cannons are siegemakers located at Grom'gar in Frostfire Ridge. They are operated by Iron Cannoneers and fired at Gentle Clefthooves.
Iron Reinforcements are orcs located in The Pit in Gorgrond. After 's takeover of the Iron Horde, they also appeared in the Iron Docks.
Iron Reinforcements are orcs located in during the Defense of Karabor.
Iron Stalker was a submarine of the Iron Horde. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Iron Stalker, Mk II was a submarine of the Iron Horde. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
__NOTOC__ Iron Dwarf Magi are iron dwarves located in the Terrace of the Makers in the Storm Peaks.
The Ireroot Seeds are provided as an objective for Nature's Reprisal.
The Iron Horde Chest can be found in the Foundry Terminus, near the entrance to the Iron Maidens of Blackrock Foundry. It is spawned after killing Operator Thogar.
Iron Claws is a Guardian druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Rage of the Sleeper (artifact trait), Vicious Bites, and Wildflesh traits.
Iron Clusterpult is a siegemaker located in Frostfire Ridge during the Battle of Thunder Pass.
Iron Ballast Sabatons drops from Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Iron Cleated Warboots drops from Sergeant Mor'grak in Tanaan Jungle.
Iron Horde Propaganda notes can be found around Shaz'gul in .
Iron Bomb Spaulders drops from Kargath Bladefist in Highmaul.
The Iron Hitching Post did not make it out of the patch 5.3.0 PTR.
Iridescent Shimmerray Skin is bought from Ol' Fishbreath at Gnaws' Boneyard in Kelp'thar Forest.
Iron Horde Cannons are cannons located in Frostfire Ridge and Tanaan Jungle.
Iron Shieldbearers are orcs located in a cave in Gronn Canyon, and one dead is found in a cave in Diodor's Demise in Gorgrond. Others appear in Talador and .
Iron Riders are orcs located in . They would appear during The Survivalist's Way.
Iron Orkas is a quilboar brute located on the expedition isles.
Iron Horde Transports are boats located at Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Iron Siege Rams are battering rams located at the Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Iron Air Reavers are orcs riding Iron War Rylaks at Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Iron Shieldborns are three dead orcs located in the Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Irate Pa'kura Priests are Zandalari trolls located in the Terrace of the Chosen in Dazar'alor.
Iron Horde Supply Crates are found in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
The Iron March was the name of the road carved by the Iron Horde from Grommar to Akama's Scar in Karabor in during the alpha.
Iron Shaman Grimbeard is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Vol'dun during Faction Assaults.
Iron Hauler is a siege engine located in Savagelands in Zuldazar during Faction Assaults.
The Iron Cache can be found at The Assembly of Iron in Ulduar after defeating Assembly of Iron.
__NOTOC__ Iridescent Glimmershells are crabs located in Nazjatar.
Iron Joker is created with Inscription. It can be traded with Professor Thaddeus Paleo for any other card from the Iron Deck.
The Iron-Flecked Sandals drop from trash mobs in Blackrock Foundry.
Iron Horde Rejuvenation Potion drops from various Iron Horde mobs and Iron Horde Supply Crates in Assault on the Dark Portal, the phased level 90 version of Tanaan Jungle.
The Iron Horde Bonfire is located in the Sulfur Basin in Gorgrond.
The Iridescent Tincture is located in the Moldering Foyer in Stormsong Valley. Drinking the mixture will grant Abhorrent Constitution increasing stamina by 5% for five minutes.

__NOTOC__ Iridescent Amberjacks can be fished from Iridescent Amberjack Schools. The chance to fish them up can be increased by using Iridescent Amberjack Bait. They can be added to an active Empty Kettle of Stone Soup.
Iremore Necklace is looted from Abandoned Belongings and Secret Treasures in Revendreth.
Iridescent Starlight Rose Petals are looted from Iridescent Starlight Roses in Suramar.
Iridescent Aethrils are found at the Lost Orchard in Azsuna.
Iron Fists was an Azerite trait available to Windwalker monks.
Ionata's Fangs drop from Examiner Ionata at Archivam in Revendreth.
Iridescent Amberjack Bait increases the chance of catching Iridescent Amberjack.
The Iron Skull Belt Buckle is looted from Garment Trunks in Revendreth. It also drops from District Aristocrats and Chalice Residents.
Iron Fortress is an Azerite trait available to Protection warriors.
__NOTOC__ Iron Summit Guards are Dark Iron dwarf guards located at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.
Iremoore Estate is the residence of House Iremoore, located in the Redelav District.
Iron Laborers are orcs located in The Pit in Gorgrond. They appear to be from the and s. Corpses of dead orcs are found in the Slagworks of the Blackrock Foundry.
Iron Enforcers are orcs located in The Pit in Gorgrond. Some of the males appear to be from the .
Iron Horde Soldiers are two dead orcs located in a cave in Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

The Iron Stonegrinder is a big drill found in the Thunder Pass in Frostfire Ridge. It faces the boulders that collapsed during the Battle of Thunder Pass, and it tried to dig through. The Horde sent the Frostwall Commander and Gazlowe to sabotage it.
Iron Berserkers are orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Iron Crag-Leapers are orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Iron Gladiators are orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Iron Talons are orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Iron Horde Battlebeast is a clefthoof ridden by Lieutenant O'rok in Gorgrond.
Iron Boats are boats carrying Grom'kar soldiers to Orunai Coast in Talador.
Iron-Kelp Wristwraps drops from Viq'Goth in the Siege of Boralus.
Iridescent Ravioli with Apple Sauce is created with Cooking (50); taught by trainers.
Iron Testers are training dummies located in the cave in the southern end of the Seat of the Primus.
Iron Branch drops from Ironbranch in Shala'nir in Val'sharah.
__NOTOC__ Irestone Rumblers are earth elementals located in Deepholm.
Iredeemable Trash can be obtained by feeding weapons to Jaithys, the Prison Blade, or by scrapping Sanctum of Domination equipment at the Scrap-O-Matic 1000/Shred-Master Mk1.
The Iron Maiden's Toolkit is looted from the Helsworn Chest in Desmotaeron in the Maw.
Iron Spiked Handgrips drop from Grand Proctor Beryllia in Sanguine Depths.
__NOTOC__ Iristia the Unburdened is a kyrian located in Bastion.
Iron Shredder Operation Manual Vol. X (Abridged) was never made available. It might have been involved in Vol. X Pages ?.
Iron Phillip's Problem Solver is an appearance unlocked by Arsenal: Stitchmasters' Weapons.
Iridescent Peafowl are peafowl located at the Wild Cliffs in Thaldraszus.
Iridescent Ore can be obtained from any ore node on the Dragon Isles. Players may only discover 1 sample per week.
Iridescent Ore Fragments can be obtained from any ore node in the Dragon Isles. Players may only discover 5 per week.
__NOTOC__ Iridescent Plume is a currency item drop by Sunwing Ohuna and Longwing Skyhunter.
__NOTOC__ Iridescent Water is a crafting reagent sold by vendors that is used in Dragon Isles Inscription.
Iridescent Warcloak is a pink cosmetic cloak available for purchase for 75 Trader's Tender at the Trading Post.
Iristella is a dracthyr located in Iskaara in the Azure Span.
Iristimat is a dracthyr located in Iskaara in the Azure Span.

Iridikron's Gambit is one of three tunnels connecting to Zaralek Cavern. This tunnel connects Cascades Canyon in eastern Ohn'ahran Plains with the Throughway at in eastern Zaralek Cavern and serves as players' first path to the zone.
__NOTOC__ Iron Grimshots are fel orcs located in Tanaan Jungle.
__NOTOC__ Iron Battle Engines are siegemakers located in Tanaan Jungle.
__NOTOC__ Iron Taskmaster is an orc located in Blackrock Foundry.
__NOTOC__ Iron Eviscerators are orcs located in Blackrock Foundry.
The Iron Horde Attack Orders can be found somewhere in The Pit of Gorgrond. Reading the book will reward the In Plain Sight achievement.
Iridal, the Earth's Master drops from Iridikron the Stonescaled in the Dawn of the Infinite.
Iron Rune Sages are iron dwarves located in Ivald's Ruin in Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Guardians are iron dwarves located at Giants' Run in the Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Binders are iron dwarves located at Giants' Run in the Howling Fjord.
Iron Rune Sentinels are iron golems found around Giants' Run in Howling Fjord. Once slain, they can be mined for crystallized earth.

__NOTOC__ Iron Boot Flask turns the player into an Iron Dwarf for 10 minutes, with a 1 hour cooldown. If attacked while transformed, it has a roughly 10% chance to proc Electric Discharge, which hits attackers for very limited nature damage, and this effect can be triggered at any level.

Iron Rune-Smiths are iron dwarves found at Dun Argol in Grizzly Hills.
Ironfeather Armor is a caster-oriented two-piece set crafted by Leatherworking.
Ironaya is an elite mini-boss found in the Map Chamber in Uldaman. Ironaya tries to guard the secrets of Uldaman from curious adventurers. She becomes available after activating a Keystone.
__NOTOC__ Ironspine is a rare mob skeleton who resides in the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard.
Ironfel is one of the two legendary hammers made by Franclorn Forgewright. The other is Ironfoe.
Iron Will increases a warrior's resistance to Stun and Charm effects.

__NOTOC__ Ironeye the Invincible is a rare mob basilisk that lived in the eastern part of Shimmering Flats in the Thousand Needles. As of Cataclysm, it has been moved to the ridge due to the flooding of the zone.

Ironfeathers drop from high-level bird-like mobs in the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. Winterspring Screechers, found in the eastern extremes of Winterspring, drop up to three ironfeathers on almost every kill.
Ironfeather Breastplate is crafted with Leatherworking (290); taught by Pattern: Ironfeather Breastplate.
__NOTOC__ Ironforge Commendation Officer was a dwarf quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge during the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort world event.

Ironstone Plateau is a region in northeastern Un'Goro Crater. It is home to fledgling Pterrordax, and features several stretches of bare rock tucked on the bare edge of the crater wall. Its secluded and monster-free area sometimes attracts guilds to hold guild meets there.

Ironband's Compound lies south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh, and is a base of operations for a band of Dark Iron dwarves who readily assault anyone unfortunate enough to wander too close. It was formerly inhabited by Sturgy Ironband. Warriors come to the compound in order to aid a fallen dwarf and secure evidence of the Dark Irons' presence for Ironforge in Ironband's Compound (quest).
Ironband's Excavation Site is located in southeastern Loch Modan, south of the Loch and southwest of Farstrider Lodge.

Ironbeard's Tomb is located just west of the road to Dun Modr in the north-central part of the Wetlands. The crypt has been defiled by oozes in black, crimson, and monstrous varieties, and none who wish to bury their dead come here any longer. Adventurers used to journey to the tomb in hopes of locating Sida's lost bag, which could rarely be found on any given ooze in the area. Besides the crypt, there is also a graveyard and a dwarven statue, presumably of Ironbeard himself.

Ironstone Camp is a small Horde camp at the border of the Shimmering Flats. This small group of Horde was sent to drive out the dwarven excavators from the Rustmaul Digsite, but got much more than they bargained for when the Silithid erupted from a nearby cave and attacked them. One of the members present, Moktar Krin, sends out other members of the Horde to kill the Silithid infesting the digsite.
Ironspine's Fist is a rare one-hand mace designed for melee classes.
Ironbeak Screechers are level 52-53 owls found in northern Felwood.
Ironjaw Basilisks are basilisks found in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
